slides.title: Welcome to Slide Deck
slides.subtitle: A modern, IFD-built presentation system
slides.notes: This is the opening slide. Introduce yourself and the topic.

slides.title: Key Features
content: Built with Web Components — no frameworks
slides.notes: Emphasize the framework-free approach and IFD methodology.

slides.title: How It Works
content: The frontend uses native Web Components for the slide deck and individual slides. Each component is self-contained with its own styles and behavior.
The backend is a FastAPI server that serves slide content as JSON. This enables dynamic content, live updates, and easy content management.

slides.title: Navigation
slides.content: Use arrow keys (← →) or swipe to navigate between slides. Press F for fullscreen. Press Home/End to jump to first/last slide.

slides.title: Roadmap
slides.notes: This follows IFD versioning — minor versions for features, major for consolidation.
